competences.description: Attacks the enemy with an Energy ball. The attack has a 75% chance of increasing the enemy's chance to land a Glancing Hit for 2 turns.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to decrease their Attack Speed for 2 turns. Also increases their skill cooldown time by 1 turn each with an 80% chance.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
Puts the target's skill on cool down.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times with spirit balls, having each attack to increase the skill cooldown for 1 turn, and recovers HP by 50% of the inflicted damage. The cooldown time of [Absorb Energy] decreases by 1 turn whenever you increase the enemy's skill cooldown time.

effets.description: Puts the target's skill on cool down.
Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill
Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: whenever increases the enemy's skill cooldown time
